searchText: Wrote up this doc for zk proving setup, would be great if folks could have a look and review it. Planning to add this to panda docs <@402080271563751435> do you have a link i can see it? It's a private repo 😕 Just reviewed it (by hackmd.io btw), in the diagram `ere-verifier` not in `zkboost` is a bit confusing initially (but I can see the explanation in the following notes), otherwise this looks really pretty clear to me! The `zkboost` param part also looks correct to me. (btw I found [the comment in this example](https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/blob/main/.github/tests/examples/zkboost_in_process_verifier.yaml#L12-L14) can be removed, the latest `zkboost` image should support in-process verifier for all zkVMs, no need to do custom build anymore) The idea for separation was to show request flow(esp since there's the verifier-crate now, which can allow to have a separate verifier only node down the line) but if you suggest to have that within zkboost block, that would be fair too yes, the comment was made when the zkboost zisk-verifier PR was up, will fix
